messages:
sam: heads-up — onboarding customer (ACME Corp) hitting 400 from /v1/embeddings/rerank when sending batched embeddings. They see "InvalidPayload: embedding dims mismatch: expected 1024 got 1536". Customer request id: req_0b12c9f4. Can someone triage? seen around 2025-06-01 15:02 UTC

tara: thanks — can you paste the exact curl + payload they used? also which model variant (rwd-embed-1k?) and whether they precomputed embeddings or expect server-side embedding? any gateway latency spikes?

sam: pasting sanitized curl + note (API key redacted, payload truncated for brevity):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings/rerank" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "X-Request-ID: req_0b12c9f4" \\n  -d '{\n    "model":"rwd-embed-1k",\n    "queries":[[0.01,0.02, ... truncated ... 0.03]],\n    "documents":[\n      [[0.1,0.2, ... 0.0]],   // doc0 len 1024\n      [[0.1,0.2, ... 0.0],[0.05,...]] // doc1 nested list => client sent per-chunk embeddings, causes shape mismatch\n    ]\n  }'\n```
(note: customer claims they precomputed embeddings and sent them in the request)

michael: quick theory — rerank expects either: a) documents as list of raw strings for server embedding, OR b) documents as a flat list of vectors with consistent dim (batch, dim). The nested arrays you pasted look like per-chunk embeddings inside a single document (i.e., [[vec1],[vec2]]), which will change the inferred shape and break validation. If one chunk is 1536 long while model expects 1024 you get this exact error.

tara: can you paste the proxy/runtime log lines for req_0b12c9f4 (status, error message, node id, model hash)? we need to confirm it failed during validate_embeddings() and get the internal id for eng-ml.

sam: logs (sanitized):
```
2025-06-01T15:02:03Z proxy: request=req_0b12c9f4 status=400 route=/v1/embeddings/rerank err="InvalidPayload: embedding dims mismatch: expected 1024 got 1536" model=rwd-embed-1k node=gw-07
2025-06-01T15:02:03Z runtime: validate_embeddings() failed at embeddings.py:142 internal_id=ml-err-9981
```

miranda: next steps to repro with customer — ask them to: 1) send the *exact* JSON body they POSTed (raw, not prettified), 2) include the full X-Request-ID header, 3) provide base64 of one offending embedding vector or the exact length of each vector in the batch. Provide them this local repro curl to run so we get a fresh request id: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings/rerank" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <their_key>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -H "X-Request-ID: repro_1901234567_local" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1k","queries":[0.01,0.02,...],"documents":[[0.1,0.2,...],[0.1,0.2,...,0.03, extra]]}'
```
(we want the repro to hit the same validation path so include same model and same shape)

michael: also ask them to run this quick python check on their payload file to output vector lengths per document so we can see mismatch without sending keys: 
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,sys
obj=json.load(open('payload.json'))
for i,d in enumerate(obj.get('documents',[])):
    # handle if doc is list of vectors vs single vector
    if isinstance(d[0], list):
        lens=[len(v) for v in d]
        print(f'doc',i,'chunked_lengths=',lens)
    else:
        print('doc',i,'length=',len(d))
PY
```

tara: to collect runtime context on our side please ask customer to run the support debug helper (or we can run server-side if they grant permission). We can also collect a debug bundle on the cluster for req_0b12c9f4: run `redwoodctl collect --req req_0b12c9f4 --include-logs`. support-bot: automated note — if collecting bundle, mask API keys and PII before upload.

sam: customer ran local check and reports: doc0 length=1024, doc1 chunk lengths=[512,512,512] and they concatenated them client-side into a single list lazily, which produced 1536 for one of the transmitted vectors. so client concat bug — but we still need to provide clear error and a helpful repro path.

miranda: proposed reply to customer: short explanation + reproducible curl + ask for the raw JSON + offer assistance to reformat payload. Example: 
"It looks like one of your documents was sent as multiple chunk vectors (e.g., [[v1],[v2]]) which our validation treats as separate vectors — when concatenated or mis-sized one chunk produced length 1536 vs the model's 1024. Please either send a single vector per document of length 1024, or send raw text strings and let the API embed them server-side. Can you attach the raw JSON you POSTed? If you'd like we can run a quick reformat and resend for testing."

michael: tagging eng-ml for visibility: @miranda please assign ml-issue-9981 if we need a code change to make validation error more explicit or tolerant for chunked uploads.

miranda: I'll take it from here, will follow up with customer and request the raw payload + run `redwoodctl collect --req req_0b12c9f4 --include-logs` on cluster side once we have permission. assigning to eng-ml. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Reminder — created support case SC-2025-419 for req_0b12c9f4 and attached log snippet.

sam: thanks all, updating the customer that eng-ml will follow up.
